preconditions.description: The number of points n is between 3 and 2000 inclusive.
Each point's coordinates are between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of points matches the given n.
The length of the string s is n-2.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'LR' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of 'L' and 'R'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value.split()) == n and all(1 <= int(p) <= n for p in return_value.split()) and len(set(return_value.split())) == n)
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or a permutation of integers from 1 to n.
If the output is '-1', no valid permutation exists.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or is_non_self_intersecting_and_winding(points, [int(p) for p in return_value.split()], s)
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the permutation forms a non-self-intersecting and winding polygonal line.
